Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Apple's AirPods Live Translation setup - a bottom sheet presents the AirPods illustration while greeting words in many languages float and cycle around it, then steps through language download, pause-media, and charging sheets.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dimmed Music app behind. Sheet one: "Live Translation (Beta)" with body copy, an AirPods illustration ringed by floating words (Hello, Bonjour, Gracias, Danke, Ciao, Adios, Merci, Thanks, Bye), a blue "Set Up Live Translation" button and "Not Now". Sheet two: "Select and Download Languages" with a checkmark list and Continue. Sheet three: "Pause Media When I Fall Asleep" with a speaker-and-Zzz illustration. Sheet four: "Charging AirPods" with the case illustration and Done.

## Motion spec
Pattern: multi-step sheet with ambient word float, ~450ms per step.
- Words: each greeting drifts on a slow orbit around the AirPods (8-14s periods, varied radii), fading out and being replaced by the next language (400ms crossfade) every ~2s.
- Glow: a soft ambient pulse breathes behind the illustration (2.5s, opacity 20-35%).
- Step change: sheet content crossfades (250ms) while the sheet grows or shrinks to fit (spring ~340/28, 400ms); the new illustration settles with a small rise (12px, 300ms).
- The Zzz marks float up and fade (1.6s loop, staggered); the charging case shows a rising fill.

## Calibration
- Words stay inside the illustration band - none overlap the title or buttons.
- Each step's illustration has its own idle loop; only the language sheet cycles words.

## Reduced motion
Words are static; illustrations hold one frame; steps crossfade only.

## Don't miss
- The floating words swap languages continuously - a fixed set of words is wrong.
- The sheet resizes per step with a spring, not a jump.
